description: Source code for managing user attribute fields in Mattermost CLI, including listing, creating, editing, and deleting CPA (Custom Profile Attribute) fields via Cobra commands.

classes.name: cobra.Command
classes.description: Defines CLI commands for managing user attribute fields

methods.name: cpaFieldListCmdF
methods.description: Lists all CPA fields, outputs in JSON or formatted text

methods.name: cpaFieldCreateCmdF
methods.description: Creates a new CPA field with specified name and type

methods.name: cpaFieldEditCmdF
methods.description: Edits an existing CPA field based on provided arguments and flags

methods.name: cpaFieldDeleteCmdF
methods.description: Deletes a specified CPA field after confirmation
